change_summary: The editors published an expression of concern about the paper "Gut bacteria and mood in mice". They say concerns have been raised about some of the data reported and that the matter is being looked into. The notice does not say which data are involved, and gives no outcome yet, so the findings are in doubt but not retracted.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites [8] for the claim that gut bacteria play a causal role in depressive behaviour, and says your proposal builds on that finding. The editors have issued an expression of concern saying they have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data, and that the matter is being looked into. The notice does not say which data or figures are involved, so it is uncertain whether the transplant result you rely on is affected. Because your argument and proposal rest on this finding, the change matters to a moderate degree.
recommendation: Hedge the Discussion's reliance on Lopez and Chen [8] and cite the notice, because the editors say they have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data and that the matter is being looked into. Don't build new work on it yet, since the notice does not say which data are involved and so it is unclear whether the transplant result is affected.
